payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and results related to recovering from noisy entity linking in query generation systems.

claims.text: The system can still generate correct answers in 85% of cases despite an 11.4% decline in precision due to noisy entity linking.
Query structures are ranked and validated, allowing the system to filter out many erroneous linking results through checks like empty query and domain/range validation.
Using a merging module improves recall significantly, especially with limited training data, despite a slight decrease in precision.
